item.title: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!: My Gift Hath Been Recieved!
item.content:encoded:
Here it is!

This is a beautiful art depicting SCP-5346. I absolutely love the art-style, the colors, and the little detail omitting the "is" and the "was."

In truth, I have absolutely no idea who could've possibly made this art. Its absolutely stunning and fantastic, and a hell-of-a-lot of creativity was definitely put into it. I am immensely grateful for such a fantastic gift. What do yall think of it?! ;-;

SCP-370-J is a event where the heat turns off when your taking a shower for NO DAMN REASON AT ALL! I had to go in the basement, sopping wet in a TOWEL, just to see there was no one! I. WAS. PISSED.

item.content:encoded:
SCP-5929

SCP-XXXX-1 is a brown doll. On SCP-XXXX-1 is purple clothing, a golden harness and a black mask with feathers on top of it. The exact details of the clothing and mask vary slightly between different people. When SCP-XXXX-1 comes in contact with human skin or blood, SCP-XXXX-2 manifests next to SCP-XXXX’s mask. SCP-XXXX-2 is a pill, similar in appearance to SCP-500. When SCP-XXXX-2 is consumed orally, SCP-XXXX-1 will shake vigorously until it’s mask falls off, revealing a black liquid1. When SCP-XXXX-3 touches a physical object, it usually turns into a different material however there are cases where the material disappears entirely.

Deleted at -21 and three votes.

SCP-5187 can be described as a 6’4” female half elf, half centipede centaur with four centipede legs, a centipede pincer on its rear end, green eyes, and ginger hair, it speaks with a light Norse accent.

SCP-5187's legs can crush objects up to 56 kilograms, and its pincer can snap objects up to 39 kilograms. It can paralyze beings with a touch of its hand, turn invisible at will, and stretch its skin to devour its prey.

Deleted at -18 and three votes.

SCP-5127-1 is a humanoid entity reaching 10 feet in height, and weighing 517 pounds. The entity's arms are disproportionate to its body, reaching down to its ankles, and ending in long, claw-like fingers. The entity's legs and torso seem to be proportionate to its height. It is skinny and boney, wears no clothing, and has skin the color of rustic metal. SCP-5127-1 is not to be viewed through photography or video. All who do are to be labeled as an SCP-5127-3 instance, and they are to be contained appropriately. Artwork of the entity does not have the same effect. SCP-5127-1 has the ability to open small holes across it's entire body. When this happens, the entity can play any known sound at any volume at any known location. Possible sounds can include conversations, music, and sound effects. And person who views the entity during this process will experience extreme symptoms of tripnaphobia, even if they have never had it before. SCP-5127-1 was brought into containment after reports came that an entire village had been killed, and that anybody who had walked into the village had not come out. This village has been marked as SCP-5127-2, and anomalous effects are as follows.

Deleted at -17 and three votes.
